[EN] Be prepared. That's my motto, or it would be if I started having a motto.

If your experience with your leopard friend goes...poorly, I want a soporific on hand to put the beast safely to sleep. Something dreamy would be nice.

4
[ES] Esté preparado. Ese es mi lema, o lo sería si empezara a tener un lema.

Si tu experiencia con tu amigo leopard sale... mal, quiero tener un soporífico a mano para dormir a la bestia de forma segura. Algo de ensueño estaría bien.

4

[EN] Ah, yes. A morpheutic draught. That will do nicely.

We don't want to hurt the animal, just make it so it doesn't eat your face.4
[ES] Ah, sí. Una morpheutic draught. Eso servirá muy bien.

No queremos hacerle daño al animal, solo lograr que no se coma tu cara.4

[EN] I certainly wouldn't approach a beast this size without a draught.
[ES] Ciertamente no me acercaría a una bestia de este tamaño sin una draught.
